text:
Predicates:
Infectious(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
Caused(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
Occur(x, y) ::: x can occur in y.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
Get(x, y) ::: x gets y.
Premises:
Infectious(monkeypox) ∧ Caused(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
∃x (Occur(monkeypoxVirus, x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
∀x (Human(x) → Mammal(x)) ::: Humans are mammals.
∀x (Mammal(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Mammals are animals.
∃x (Symptom(x, monkeypox)) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
∃x (Get(x, glu) → FeelTired(x)) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion:
∃x (Animal(x)) ::: There is an animal.
